subject: Request: temporary amendment to P1/P2 on-call coverage for Fintegrate
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@fintegrate.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: support@fintegrate.com
Date: 2026-11-03T15:12:00+01:00
Subject: Latency / coverage gap overnight 2026-11-02 -> request for temporary SLA amendment

Hi Sofia,

We had a repeat of the overnight latency incident (00:20–00:45 UTC) that impacted our low-latency routing. On our end it resulted in several failed trade authorizations and a downstream reconciliation delay. The issue appears to be a capacity/serving fallback outside Redwood's primary region during the 00:00–06:00 UTC window.

Given the criticality to our market-making flows, Finance/OPS have asked if Redwood can provide an elevated on-call coverage (P1/P2) for an interim period while we complete the joint root-cause work. Specifically, we are requesting:

- Dedicated P1 on-call coverage (direct engineer escalation) from 00:00–06:00 UTC for two weeks starting 2026-11-06.
- A standby secondary (engineering) contact after 20 minutes if L1 cannot remediate.
- A mutually agreed SLA credit or one-time operational credit for incidents during that window.

I attached logs and a short incident summary. Please let me know what information you need and whether Redwood can provision this temporary amendment. We can schedule a quick call tomorrow morning (CET) if helpful.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of SRE, Fintegrate
Daniel.Park@fintegrate.com
Attachment: incident_snapshot_20261102.png (image/png)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@fintegrate.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-03T16:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Latency / coverage gap overnight 2026-11-02 -> request for temporary SLA amendment

Hi Daniel — thanks for the quick summary and the logs.

We can triage this immediately. I will: 
- Kick off an internal review with on-call and infra (copying Lauren).
- Prepare a short exception package (coverage window, escalation path, and credit structure) for your review by end of tomorrow CET.
- Propose a temporary rotation and runbook updates that limit operational impact on our broader fleet.

Could you confirm the requested start date (you mentioned 2026-11-06) and whether two weeks is acceptable on your side? If you have a preferred time for a short call, propose 09:30–10:00 CET tomorrow.

Regards,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Technical Account Lead — Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T17:22:00+01:00
Subject: Fwd: Latency / coverage gap overnight 2026-11-02 -> Fintegrate exception request

Rishi / Lauren — forwarding Fintegrate's ask. Key points: temporary P1 direct-engineer coverage overnight (00:00–06:00 UTC) for two weeks starting 2026-11-06; secondary escalation after ~20 minutes; request for one-time operational credit.

My recommended approach:
- Approve a timeboxed coverage window for 14 days only, with clear start/end timestamps.
- Primary coverage: support on-call (existing rotation) takes initial triage for first 10 minutes; if not resolved, escalate immediately to the dedicated infra engineer (we will nominate two engineers per week to avoid fatigue).
- If incident persists >30 minutes, trigger engineering pager and optional managerial escalation (Rishi) for cross-team swaps.
- Offer Fintegrate a one-time credit equal to one day of baseline monthly usage (or equivalent token credit) in lieu of SLA retro credits.
- Require signed exception form and an agreed runbook update before the start date.

I attached a draft rotation sheet (coverage_rotations.xlsx) and the SLA_exception_form.pdf template. The operational cost is moderate but manageable if we limit the timeframe and get written acceptance.

Can you confirm if you approve this approach and if I should proceed to send formal terms to Fintegrate?

Thanks,
Sofia
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency / coverage gap overnight 2026-11-02 -> Fintegrate exception request

Sofia — thanks for the framing. A couple of operational guardrails before we commit: 

1) Limit the exception to EXACTLY 14 calendar days and document start/end UTC timestamps in the form.
2) We cannot add additional long-term headcount. Nominate engineers only from the existing infra on-call pool; rotation must be explicit and rotate every 3–4 days.
3) The proposed credit is OK as long as Finance signs off; please loop in Finance if Fintegrate insists on retroactive SLA credits instead of an upfront operational credit.
4) Require a joint runbook review with our infra lead and Fintegrate SRE before the first shift.

I approve conditional on those constraints. Proceed to send the exception form to the customer and get formal acceptance. If they request an extension beyond 14 days, escalate to me for review.

-Rishi
VP, Support Operations
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@fintegrate.com>, support@fintegrate.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T14:40:00+01:00
Subject: Exception terms and signature request — Fintegrate temporary overnight coverage (00:00–06:00 UTC)

Hi Daniel — per our internal review, we can provide a timeboxed exception with the following terms: 

- Coverage window: 2026-11-06T00:00:00Z through 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z (UTC) — 14 calendar days.
- Operational flow: support on-call initial triage (0–10 min); escalate to infra engineer (10–30 min); engineering pager and managerial alert after 30 minutes.
- Roster: two engineers will be nominated each 3-day block; roster to be shared 48 hours before start.
- Credit: one-time operational credit equivalent to one day of baseline monthly usage; no retroactive SLA payout unless separately approved by Finance.
- Preconditions: signed SLA_exception_form.pdf and joint runbook review scheduled at least 24 hours prior to start.

Please review and sign here: https://hubspot.company.com/deals/D-13245 (DocuSign link embedded on page). Attached: SLA_exception_form.pdf (fillable).

If accepted, we will share the detailed rotation spreadsheet and final runbook. Happy to run a 20‑minute sync tomorrow 09:30 CET to go through the runbook.

Best,
Sofia
Technical Account Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachment: SLA_exception_form.pdf
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@fintegrate.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: support@fintegrate.com
Date: 2026-11-05T09:41:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Exception terms and signature request — Fintegrate temporary overnight coverage (00:00–06:00 UTC)

Sofia — thanks, this looks good. We reviewed internally and accept the 14‑day window and the credit terms. I have completed and uploaded the exception form via the HubSpot/DocuSign flow and scheduled the runbook review for 2026-11-05 09:00 UTC.

Please confirm the roster when available and the expected notification format for any incident (pager + Slack channel). We'll be on the 09:30 CET call tomorrow.

Regards,
Daniel
